title: Fixed Two-Row Bar and Resonator Frame
description: One original complete fixed two-row wooden-bar percussion frame with individually separated length-graded bars, shallow arched bar undersides, four longitudinal support cords, separate open-top closed-bottom resonator-style pipes, two pipe support rails and four grounded legs. Staggered raised rear row and open pipe bank differ from a keyboard case or membrane drum. Entire new geometry. Static musical instrument exterior only; no calibrated note sequence, tuning, acoustic performance, vibration, playable suspension, manufacture, loading or structural safety claim.
